//: Copy to appsettings.json and fill in. appsettings.json is gitignored and must never be committed.

AppSettings.//Token: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for JWTs. Use 32+ random bytes. In Azure this is set as the AppSettings__Token application setting.

Sentry.//: Optional. Leave Dsn empty to disable error reporting locally.

Analytics.//UseActivityEvents: false reads activity from the source tables; true reads the denormalised ActivityEvents table once it has been backfilled.

//Mail: SMTP credentials used for verification codes and report delivery.
